input.content: Pattern: ownership-scoped cleanup "simplified" into unconditional delete. Failed-job cleanup that deletes a shared per-key slot (e.g. store.active[workspace_id]) must compare ownership (setup_id/token) before removing — a newer job may have completed and claimed the slot before the queued cleanup runs. Dropping the `if owner == me` guard deletes the successor's live state and existing tests often still pass because they only cover the self-owned case. Review check: when a cleanup/rollback removes a key shared across jobs, require a compare-and-delete and a test where another owner completes first.
